summary: Public veterinary directory built on the Phase 1 vet_profile and vet_location rows, without a parallel veterinarian table. Migration 0020 adds province (31, seeded) and city (31 provincial capitals seeded; superadmin adds others, one name per province) with optional province_code/city_id on vet_location, backfilled from the Phase 1 free text with Arabic yeh/kaf unified and the text left as history; CAT joins the species taxonomy while the breed bank is held to DOG; vet_specialty (15 seeded areas of practice), vet_profile_specialty and vet_profile_species; public columns on vet_profile (DRAFT/PUBLISHED/HIDDEN, stable random slug, headline, experience, consent to show phone and council code) and is_public/hours note on vet_location. The superadmin edits a veterinarian's public page at /admin/vets/[accountId] (linked from the Phase 1 registry): five status axes shown separately (computed Completeness, Ownership, Professional Verification from council_verified_at, Trusted from the active TRUSTED_VET role, Advertising none), profile with specialties, species and consent, location placement and visibility, publication and city creation; every change needs a reason, carries the expected version and is audited field by field with before/after. Publishing needs a bio and a public location with a city; hidden, draft, disabled-account and unknown addresses are 404 and absent from the sitemap. Visitors use /veterinarians with name, specialty, species, province, city, location kind and a single status axis filter, and /veterinarians/[slug] with consent-gated contact, active public locations, announced hours as information only, canonical, Person/VeterinaryCare JSON-LD and breadcrumb; the section is live in the header, footer and sitemap. The Finder's conditions and data are untouched. Phase 1 fix: upsertVetProfile no longer clears the bio when the registry form omits it.
